description: Get NHTSA 5-Star Safety Ratings (overall, frontal crash, side crash, rollover and rollover risk) for each tested variant of a vehicle by make, model and model year. Use when the user asks how safe a car is or wants to compare crash-test results. Many low-volume vehicles are never tested.

model.description: Model name as sold in the US, e.g. Accord, F-150, Model 3

name: get_safety_ratings
title: Get crash-test ratings
